oracles.historical_mechanism: Hypothesis, prediction, falsifier and setup are SHA-256 sealed; SQLite BEFORE UPDATE trigger aborts later mutation.
required_tests: Seal a preregistration and prove mutation of hypothesis fails before any measurement is accepted.
Seal a preregistration and prove mutation of prediction/falsifier/setup fails.
Prove measurement/result fields can be appended without changing the preregistration hash.
Recompute the seal from canonical fields and reject mismatched stored hashes.
Bind preregistration to source/state epoch so replay cannot attach a valid old seal to a different episode.
oracles.acceptance_invariant: No causal/scientific result may retroactively alter the hypothesis, prediction, falsifier or setup it claims to test.

required_tests: Feed byte-identical primary/shadow states: distance may be zero and convergence may be true.
Inject one controlled state-field difference: distance must become non-zero or the metric must explicitly abstain; it must not silently remain zero/stable.
Inject multiple differences across typed state regions and verify monotonic/specified sensitivity rather than constant output.
Use repeated stable checkpoint identity across time; unique labels alone cannot count as longitudinal convergence evidence.
Shuffle primary/shadow pairing and require convergence quality to degrade.
Lesion the compared-state input and require fail/UNKNOWN rather than default stable=true.
oracles.acceptance_invariant: A convergence metric that cannot leave its all-zero/all-stable state under controlled divergence has no evidential authority.

required_tests: Separate value-overlap caused by copied stores, shared vocabularies/enums, measurement artifacts and genuine cross-state dependency.
Run a frequency-preserving or otherwise matched null model before promoting latent overlap to dependency.
Preserve measured, derived and model-proposed graph edges as distinct epistemic classes.
Do not claim UnifiedDB superiority unless matched source-local/ATTACH/graph baselines show capability or cost improvement under the same query set.
oracles.acceptance_invariant: Shared values or graph density alone never establish functional coupling.
